title: 낙동강수계관리위원회규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:21565:20090626:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Decree of the Korea Rural Community Corporation and Farmland Management Fund Act) <Presidential Decree No. 21565, June 26, 2009>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on June 30, 2009: Provided, That Article 3 of the Addendum shall enter into force on the date of promulgation. <Other parts omitted>
Article 2 Omitted.
Article 3 (Amendment of Other Statutes) (1) through (8) Omitted.
(9) In Article 6 (3) 4 of the Regulations on the Nakdong River Basin Management Committee, "Korea Rural Corporation" shall be replaced with "Korea Rural Community Corporation."
(10) through (48) Omitted.
Article 4 Omitted.
